payload.author: claude
payload.body: Scoped but not started: a Postgres tsvector search adapter first requires async-ifying the FrickSearchAdapter interface (upsert/delete/query are currently sync — they can't wrap async pg), which ripples through store.ts's write-path #notifySearch + the search HTTP route + erase + tests. Part of the same 'port the remaining SQLite-bound subsystems (search/devtools/platform-events/blob-bytes) to async + wire createFrickServer to run on PG' phase. The per-store-family adapters (FR-119-122) are done; this is the next phase.
